title: Shows a small two-person submarine that really dives, surfaces, stays dry inside, steers and is boarded from the surface
from: 2026-11-13 check before the player needs one: the book had no submarine layout and the checks never proved a dry inside, a way to dive and surface from the helm, or steering
question: can you design a small submarine for 2 of us so we can go explore underwater? we have brass stuff going
player: Brass age: has Mechanical Pumps, fluid pipes, Ballast Tanks and Vents, Submarine Propellers, an Onboard Computer and Pump Controller, an Oxygen Diffuser and Electrolyzer, Portable Engines, a Steering Wheel, Analog Transmissions and a Throttle Lever, iron, copper and glass.
rubric: Shows a submarine model with no PROBLEM: it dives, surfaces and holds a depth, and the answer says how
The crew compartment is sealed so the inside stays dry under water, with a hatch they shut behind them
The crew controls dive and surface from inside at the helm (no wrenching pumps round mid-dive)
It steers with one wheel and has a throttle, both in reach of the helm, and moves at a useful speed
Boarded from the water's surface; fuel, oxygen and every control reached on foot inside; labels name real parts
